- Build a complete, playable 3D “Femboy tycoon” game for phone and tablet.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support mobile and tablet layouts and touch controls.
- Save screenshots as small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px) for checks; read only the latest screenshot.

- Styled the game as “Velvet & Vogue — Style Studio Tycoon,” a pastel boutique management game.
- Used Three.js via CDN and a custom low-poly 3D studio scene.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a responsive game UI, idle income, sales collection, upgrade shop, progression, daily challenge, sound toggle, and localStorage persistence in `index.html`.
- Added 3D boutique scene with mannequins, clothing racks, and interactive drag-to-rotate camera/studio.

### Active
- Validate JavaScript and run the game in a browser; check the rendered layout and gameplay.

### Blocked
- No known blockers.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` and verify the script parses and the app loads.
2. Launch the game and test the desktop and phone layouts, collection, upgrades, persistence, and touch rotation.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the complete game implementation.

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D “Femboy tycoon” game for phone and tablet, and validate gameplay, responsive layouts, persistence, and touch controls.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support mobile/tablet layouts and usable touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px) for checks; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Styled the game as “Velvet & Vogue — Style Studio Tycoon,” a pastel boutique management game.
- Built the 3D boutique with Three.js via CDN.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive game UI, idle income, sales collection, upgrades, progression, daily challenge, sound toggle, and localStorage persistence in `index.html`.
- Added an interactive low-poly 3D boutique scene with mannequins, clothing racks, and drag-to-rotate controls.
- Verified mobile layout at 390×844: no document overflow, upgrade list scrolls, and collect button remains visible.
- Tested an affordable rack upgrade and confirmed `levels.rack` persists after reload.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/desktop-check.jpg` at 1280×800.

### Active
- Fix desktop sidebar layout: upgrade card currently expands to ~600px and pushes the challenge and report cards below the viewport, despite the sidebar itself being scrollable.
- Recheck desktop and mobile layouts, touch rotation, and capture a fresh screenshot after layout changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Adjust desktop sidebar/card sizing so the upgrade list is independently scrollable and challenge/report cards remain accessible.
2. Revalidate desktop and mobile layouts, upgrade-list scrolling, collection visibility, and drag-to-rotate.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot (≤1280px).

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation and responsive layout; includes recent desktop sidebar CSS change.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Browser tests used `http://localhost:3002`; reload via `?fresh=1` previously avoided stale CSS.
- Touch rotation had not yet been validated using actual touch input; synthetic PointerEvents failed because `setPointerCapture` requires an active pointer.
- Latest desktop metrics: at 1280×800 the sidebar has 686px client height and 976px scroll height; the upgrade card is ~598px tall and its action list is ~541px tall. A recent `.side>.card{flex:none}` change did not resolve the overflowing card layout.
